muc.title: Ten words worth remembering
muc.text: Across nearly a hundred recent videos, these are the ten AI terms most worth remembering.

muc.title: Cutoff, limits, versions
muc.text: One, knowledge cutoff, when AI stopped learning. Two, rate limit, the cap on how many questions you can ask. Three, model version, why AI changes its style.

muc.title: How AI is taught
muc.text: Four, RLHF, short for Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback, meaning AI learns from scores given by real people. Five, sycophancy, the habit of pleasing. Six, overfitting, memorizing instead of understanding.

muc.title: Hidden instructions and agents
muc.text: Seven, system prompt, the hidden instruction. Eight, prompt injection, hidden text that gives orders. Nine, jailbreak, getting around safety guardrails. Ten, agent, AI that does several steps on its own.

muc.title: Three fuzzy terms
muc.text: Pick three terms that are still fuzzy and ask a chatbot for an everyday example of each.
